text.arabic_uthmani: وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ فَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِيهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَٰوَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هَٰذَا ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةًۭ وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّآ أَحْصَىٰهَا ۚ وَوَجَدُوا۟ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ حَاضِرًۭا ۗ وَلَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدًۭا

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the record-placement scene as continuation of the prior judgment address
words.prose: The opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the eschatological tableau and moves directly from the prior judgment address into the placement of the record. The book scene therefore feels like the next procedural event in the same summons, not a detached statement.

topics.headline: resumptive launch of the record scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the book scene continues the prior Day tableau rather than beginning as an isolated doctrine.
topics.reason: QAC and discourse evidence identify the particle as a resumptive scene opener that links the prior display before the Lord to documentary exposure.

words.gloss_range: passive perfect placing of the record, foregrounding the set-down object while delaying the named agent
words.root_gloss_range: root range of placing, setting down, laying out, and composing; local passive selects concrete placement while broader birth/composition pressure remains image-level
words.prose: {{ar:وُضِعَ}} ({{tr:wuḍiʿa}}) sets the book into the scene in the passive, so the record itself takes procedural prominence while the placer is withheld until the final Lord-subject. The qiraat contrast makes the case work visible: the canonical wording casts the book as nominative passive subject, while the active reading would cast the same book as accusative object set down by an agent. The placement root makes accountability feel physically staged without replacing the canonical passive.

topics.headline: passive placement with delayed agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the record becoming a concrete placed object before the Lord is named explicitly at the close.
topics.reason: The canonical passive and nominative book are locally decisive; variant active wording usefully exposes the voice-case contrast but does not control the canonical parse.

words.gloss_range: the definite placed record of deeds, syntactically prominent as the passive subject and semantically binding scattered deeds into evidence
words.root_gloss_range: root range of writing, prescribing, recording, and binding/joining; local noun selects the written record with binding evidentiary pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبُ}} ({{tr:al-kitābu}}) is not introduced as an unknown item; it is the definite record set down as the passive subject and evidentiary center of the scene. Its writing-and-binding root lets scattered deeds become one inscribed object, and the ayah will return to the same book inside the criminals’ own question.

topics.headline: definite record as evidentiary object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the book as the axial evidentiary object that triggers fear, speech, enumeration, and the justice claim.
topics.reason: Definiteness, nominative passive-subject role, repetition later in the ayah, and record-counting parallels support the record as the ayah’s documentary pivot.

words.gloss_range: consecutive particle marking the seeing as immediate consequence of the book’s placement
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns placement into immediate perception. Once the record is set down, the ayah moves straight into seeing the exposed criminals, so the book’s force is shown through its instant effect.

topics.headline: immediate link from placement to seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices no gap between the record being placed and the scene becoming visible to the addressed observer.
topics.reason: The particle functions as taʿqīb, linking the passive placement to the following perception clause.

words.gloss_range: second-person imperfect seeing that makes the addressee an observing witness inside the judgment scene
words.root_gloss_range: root range of seeing, perceiving, and judging/considering; local form selects visual witnessing with evaluative scene pressure
words.prose: {{ar:تَرَى}} ({{tr:tarā}}) shifts the scene into addressed, unfolding perception. The addressee sees the criminals fearful before hearing their lament, and the parallel fear scene (42:22) helps mark this as public exposure tied to consequence. Within the surah’s visual judgment motifs, the displayed earth and displayed persons now become displayed records.

topics.headline: addressed vivid seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices being pulled into the scene as a witness before the criminals speak for themselves.
topics.reason: The imperfect and second-person form create vivid witnessing; contextual parallels with 42:22 support the fear-before-consequence frame.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative active-participle label for the criminals as the seen object, morally classifying them before their lament
words.root_gloss_range: root range of cutting, committing offense, and acquiring culpability; local participle selects criminals while cutting/severance remains moral image-pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimīna}}) makes the group the object seen and classifies them before they speak. The root’s cutting-to-culpability pressure makes their crime feel like severance from right order, while the parallel with 42:22 sharpens the legal register of this fear scene.

topics.headline: criminals exposed before speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their moral status is named before sympathy can be drawn by their cry.
topics.reason: The accusative object role and definite participial label support exposed moral classification; root imagery is kept as pressure, not as a separate local action.

words.gloss_range: accusative Form IV active participle describing the criminals’ bound state of apprehensive dread during exposure
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes apprehension, tender fear, and twilight/redness; local participle selects dread while chromatic and compassion associations color the state
words.prose: {{ar:مُشْفِقِينَ}} ({{tr:mushfiqīna}}) supplies the criminals’ circumstantial state at the moment of seeing. The Form IV participle makes dread a condition they have entered, and the root’s apprehension, tender-fear, and twilight coloring give that fear a visual-emotional hue within a scene governed by sight; the 42:22 parallel keeps the dread tied to earned consequence.

topics.headline: dread state with marked emotional color
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fear is not incidental emotion but the visible state attached to the criminals as they are exposed.
topics.reason: The accusative participle functions as a ḥāl for the criminals; broader twilight and compassion associations survive only as image-pressure around the locally selected fear sense.

words.gloss_range: compound preposition marking what is in the book as the source or cause of the criminals’ dread
words.prose: {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) compresses source and relative content: their dread arises from what the record contains. The phrase can attach tightly to the fear or more broadly to the exposure, but either way the book’s contents become the pressure point.

topics.headline: contents as source of fear
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their fear comes from the book’s contents, not from the book as a mere symbol.
topics.reason: The fused min-plus-relative form supplies causal/partitive force after the fear participle.

words.gloss_range: locative phrase with attached pronoun, presenting the book as containing incriminating material
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fīhi}}) keeps the book active as the referent and makes it a container of evidence. The fear is directed toward what is inside the record, so written contents become the cause of visible dread.

topics.headline: record interiority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the record has an inside that exerts pressure on the criminals.
topics.reason: The locative preposition and pronoun refer back to the book and support an interior-content reading.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction linking visible fear with the criminals’ spoken lament
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the seeing-and-fear clause with the saying clause without restating the subject. The lament therefore does not float free; it emerges as the verbal outburst of the same exposed group whose dread has just been shown.

topics.headline: sight joined to speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their speech is the audible continuation of the exposure already seen.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the prior perception/fear sequence with the following plural speech verb.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural saying that opens the quoted lament and makes the criminals’ recognition audible
words.root_gloss_range: root range of saying, speaking, and declaring; local imperfect introduces direct speech as unfolding confession
words.prose: {{ar:يَقُولُونَ}} ({{tr:yaqūlūna}}) opens direct speech in the same vivid present texture as the seeing verb. Their words move from lament into recognition of exhaustive record, making speech function as self-incriminating confession; the same-surah regret echo with 18:42 intensifies the shift from worldly loss to judgment loss.

topics.headline: direct speech as self-incriminating confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the criminals themselves articulate the record’s reach rather than having it reported only by the narrator.
topics.reason: The imperfect plural speech verb introduces quoted material and is tied by person/number to the same accountable group that later finds its deeds present.

words.gloss_range: vocative particle governing an abstract noun of woe, converting recognition into direct outcry
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) makes the first sound of the quotation an exclamation. By governing an abstract woe noun, it dramatizes desperation as a summons to destruction rather than a request for information.

topics.headline: vocative turns analysis into outcry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quoted speech begins by summoning ruin itself rather than calmly explaining the book.
topics.reason: The vocative particle introduces the abstract lament noun and marks an exclamatory speech act.

words.gloss_range: possessed noun of woe or ruin, intensified by its form and made collective by the first-person plural suffix
words.root_gloss_range: root range of woe, ruin, and destruction; local possessed noun selects the criminals’ collective cry of doom
words.prose: {{ar:وَيْلَتَنَا}} ({{tr:waylatanā}}) turns woe into something possessed by the speakers: their ruin, not abstract sorrow. The -t- shape before the first-person plural suffix makes the lament compact and corporate, while the shared self-condemning lament formula in 5:31 frames recognition after irreversible wrongdoing.

topics.headline: collective self-woe
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the criminals claiming ruin as their own collective outcome.
topics.reason: The possessed lament noun and plural suffix support collective self-condemnation; the 5:31 formula is a concrete echo, not a replacement for the local cry.

words.gloss_range: fused interrogative-plus-preposition asking what is with this book; not the wealth noun, though same-surah sound echoes remain meaningful
words.root_gloss_range: assigned root range relates to wealth/property in other contexts; local form is the interrogative-prepositional compound, with wealth only as an audible contrast
words.prose: {{ar:مَالِ}} ({{tr:māli}}) is locally the fused question “what is with,” not the wealth noun. That limit matters because the sound still recalls the surah’s earlier wealth scenes (18:34; 18:39; 18:46), turning property confidence into bewilderment before the record.

topics.headline: bewildered question with displaced wealth echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a panic question about the book, with the surah’s earlier wealth language audibly displaced into judgment bewilderment.
topics.reason: Local grammar selects mā plus li; same-surah wealth rows survive as sound and thematic pressure, not as the selected lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: proximal demonstrative that makes the book present, visible, and confronted inside the criminals’ speech
words.root_gloss_range: demonstrative assignment has no active lexical root pressure beyond pointing and proximity in this local use
words.prose: {{ar:هَٰذَا}} ({{tr:hādhā}}) brings the record into the criminals’ immediate field: this book, here before them. The deictic force foregrounds the book inside their panic before they describe its exhaustive action, joining same-surah recognition moments where pointing marks realization after events (18:62; 18:78).

topics.headline: proximal pointing at the record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the record being pointed at as a present object that cannot be distanced.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is proximal and modifies the known record in the quoted question.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive reprise of the same record, now inside the criminals’ question rather than the narrator’s placement clause
words.root_gloss_range: root range of writing, prescribing, recording, and binding/joining; local reprise renews the written-record pressure inside quoted speech
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) is the same definite record as the opening book, but its case and role have changed inside the quotation. The shift from placed subject to questioned genitive bridges narrated evidence and subjective recognition.

topics.headline: same book reprised in panic speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same book moving from objective placement to the criminals’ own object of panic.
topics.reason: Definiteness, referent continuity, and case shift from nominative to genitive show the same record reprised in direct speech.

words.gloss_range: negation particle beginning the no-omission frame that will be completed by the exception particle and counting verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) opens the quoted no-omission construction. Together with the later exception particle, it turns “does not leave” into an affirmative claim that everything has been counted.

topics.headline: negation opening totality frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar starts by eliminating omission before converting that denial into total enumeration.
topics.reason: The negation scopes over the following verb and participates in a lā...illā restriction construction.

words.gloss_range: Form III imperfect with the book as subject, denying omission of any small or great item
words.root_gloss_range: root range of leaving, omitting, and betrayal; local verb selects non-omission while betrayal pressure makes omission feel like a breach of justice
words.prose: {{ar:يُغَادِرُ}} ({{tr:yughādiru}}) gives the book active procedural force: it does not leave anything behind. The root’s leaving-and-betrayal range is narrowed locally to non-omission, while the rare same-surah pair with 18:47 moves totality from no person left ungathered to no deed left unrecorded.

topics.headline: book leaves nothing behind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the record acting with total thoroughness, leaving no deed outside its field.
topics.reason: The local subject is the book and the construction is negated non-omission; betrayal remains semantic pressure rather than an independent local event.

words.gloss_range: indefinite feminine singular adjective used substantively for any small matter within the merism
words.root_gloss_range: root range of smallness, littleness, and low scale; local form maps smallness onto recordable moral detail
words.prose: {{ar:صَغِيرَةًۭ}} ({{tr:ṣaghīratan}}) turns smallness into a countable object of the record. As one pole of the small-great merism, it makes exhaustive accountability concrete down to the detail, with documentary parallels in 2:282 and 9:121.

topics.headline: small item as recordable unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even what seems small becomes a discrete accountable item.
topics.reason: The adjective is substantivized as an accusative object and paired with the great-item pole to express total range.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle binding the small and great poles inside one negated totality frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the small item to the large item within the same no-omission frame. The conjunction keeps the pair working as one totalizing range rather than two separate complaints.

topics.headline: connector inside the merism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two scale poles being held inside one exhaustive construction.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates the two substantivized adjective poles within the negated construction.

words.gloss_range: second negation particle explicitly denying omission at the large-item pole as well as the small-item pole
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) repeats the negation before the large item, so the second pole is not merely implied. Both ends of the scale are explicitly closed before the exception clause converts the denial into counted totality.

topics.headline: repeated negation closes the scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both ends of the scale receive their own negated slot.
topics.reason: The duplicated negation reinforces the small-great merism under the same no-omission construction.

words.gloss_range: indefinite feminine singular adjective used substantively for any great or grave matter, completing the small-great range
words.root_gloss_range: root range of greatness, largeness, magnitude, and gravity; local form maps greatness onto accountable moral weight
words.prose: {{ar:كَبِيرَةً}} ({{tr:kabīratan}}) completes the other pole of the merism. Its mirrored form and separately negated slot make the scale complete, so the following enumeration claim covers the whole range rather than a loose example pair.

topics.headline: great item completing the range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that obvious grave matters and tiny details fall under the same record.
topics.reason: The second accusative object pole mirrors the small item morphologically and structurally, completing the exhaustive scale.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the negation-exception construction and forcing the positive result that every item has been counted
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّآ}} ({{tr:illā}}) completes the restrictive construction. After the small-great range, the exception particle turns non-omission into positive enumeration: nothing is left unless it has already been counted.

topics.headline: exception converting denial into enumeration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar permits no middle state between omitted and counted.
topics.reason: The particle follows a negated verb and introduces the perfect counting clause, creating exceptive totality.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect counting verb with feminine pronoun gathering the small-great merism into a counted object
words.root_gloss_range: root range of counting, reckoning, and pebble-like granular enumeration; local Form IV selects completed exhaustive tallying
words.prose: {{ar:أَحْصَىٰهَا}} ({{tr:aḥṣāhā}}) closes the quoted complaint with completed enumeration. The attached pronoun gathers the small-great pair into the counted target, and the counting root’s pebble-like concreteness makes the reckoning feel granular rather than abstract; parallels such as 58:6 and 78:29 place the book inside a divine enumeration network.

topics.headline: completed granular enumeration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the record’s totality is not vague memory but completed, itemized reckoning.
topics.reason: The perfect Form IV and feminine object pronoun support completed exhaustive tallying; concrete pebble-counting imagery is narrowed to lexical pressure.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction moving out of the quoted lament into narrated discovery
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes narration after the quoted totality claim. The movement is from spoken recognition to experiential confirmation: the deeds themselves are found present.

topics.headline: return from speech to discovery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah shifting from what the criminals say to what they then confront.
topics.reason: The conjunction marks a new narrative stage after direct speech and before the plural finding verb.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural finding verb whose complement frame makes past deeds encountered as present reality
words.root_gloss_range: root range of finding, encountering, existence, and emotional discovery; local verb selects finding/encounter while existence pressure makes the deeds real before them
words.prose: {{ar:وَجَدُوا۟}} ({{tr:wajadū}}) turns the book’s accounting into encounter. The criminals find what they had done as present reality; the root’s existence pressure is narrowed to the fact that their deeds are not merely listed but proven there, while the broader emotional range of finding is felt only as confrontation. The realized-truth parallel in 7:44 strengthens that verification pattern.

topics.headline: finding as confronted reality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from recorded enumeration to direct confrontation with the deeds themselves.
topics.reason: The verb is transitive with a complement frame that allows the found object and present state to work together; broader emotional branches remain secondary pressure.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun leaving the object range open as whatever they did
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) leaves the object range open: whatever they did. The relative pronoun lets past actions become findable objects without narrowing them to a named class, matching the book-totality already established.

topics.headline: open relative range of deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause avoids a list because the whole range of acted things is already in view.
topics.reason: The word functions as a relative pronoun and object domain for the finding and doing clause.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural doing/working verb for completed deeds that return as present evidence
words.root_gloss_range: root range of doing, working, purposeful action, and produced deeds; local perfect selects completed accountable action
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) identifies the found material as what they worked or did. The perfect places the actions in completed worldly time, while the root’s work-field keeps accountability attached to deliberate production; same-surah deed-testing motifs culminate here in deeds made present.

topics.headline: worked actions as accountable products
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what returns is not vague guilt but the product of deliberate action.
topics.reason: The verb is governed by the relative object and refers to completed actions; broader work/product pressure supports moral accountability without overtranslating the verb.

words.gloss_range: accusative active participle marking the deeds as present, whether read as state or second complement after finding
words.root_gloss_range: root range of presence, attendance, and being on hand; local participle selects presentness while attendance imagery makes deeds feel like witnesses
words.prose: {{ar:حَاضِرًۭا}} ({{tr:ḥāḍiran}}) gives the finding clause its result: the deeds are present. Whether read as circumstantial state or second complement, the accusative makes presence the point, and the attendance sense lets the deeds feel like witnesses before the final no-wronging axiom.

topics.headline: deeds present as confronted attendees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the deeds not only remembered but standing present before the criminals.
topics.reason: Local valency permits ḥāl or second-object analysis, both yielding presentness; settlement/civilization branches are not selected beyond image-pressure.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction linking the narrated discovery to the independent no-wronging declaration
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes from narrated discovery into the final negated axiom. Because the following negation scopes over the imperfect verb rather than the discovery narrative, the finding of deeds remains affirmed evidence while the justice declaration stands as a general principle beyond the criminals’ case.

topics.headline: resumption into the justice axiom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final justice statement as the conclusion drawn from the record scene.
topics.reason: The particle opens an independent negated verbal clause after the finding scene and connects it as a conclusion.

words.gloss_range: negative particle before the imperfect verb, giving the no-wronging clause categorical ongoing force
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the following imperfect verb and makes the closing claim categorical: your Lord does not wrong. With the indefinite object at the end, the negation reaches anyone at all.

topics.headline: absolute negation of wronging
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is not only about this case but about an ongoing divine attribute.
topics.reason: The lā plus imperfect construction supports habitual/categorical negation, and its scope extends to the indefinite object.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect verb denying that the Lord wrongs anyone, after the record has placed, counted, and presented deeds
words.root_gloss_range: root range of wronging, darkness, displacement, and diminution; local verb selects injustice while those layers sharpen what is denied
words.prose: {{ar:يَظْلِمُ}} ({{tr:yaẓlimu}}) is active and tied to the explicit Lord-subject, unlike the passive opening. After placement, counting, and present deeds, the wronging root’s displacement and diminution pressure makes the denial precise: justice does not misplace, darken, or reduce what is due; the contrast with 42:22 separates human wrongdoing from divine justice.

topics.headline: active denial of displacement and diminishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no deed or person is darkened, diminished, or put out of place after the exhaustive record.
topics.reason: The local verb denies divine wronging; broader darkness/displacement/diminution senses survive as semantic layers of what the denial excludes.

words.gloss_range: noun with second-person suffix, naming the Lord as subject of the final no-wronging clause
words.root_gloss_range: root range of lordship, mastery, ownership, nurturing, and governance; local construct selects your Lord as just subject of the axiom
words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbuka}}) names the subject of the final denial and reattaches the axiom to the addressed listener through the second-person suffix. The Lord-title carries rightful governance, so no-wronging becomes an attribute of the ruler before whom the record scene unfolds, continuing the authority frame from 18:48.

topics.headline: Lord-subject reanchors the addressed listener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the agent withheld at the opening now named as the Lord who does not wrong anyone.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative subject of the negated verb, and the suffix shifts address back from the criminals’ plural lament to the listener.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular object under negation, extending the no-wronging axiom to any individual at all
words.root_gloss_range: root range of one, single, unique, and individual; local indefinite under negation distributes the justice claim across every person
words.prose: {{ar:أَحَدًۭا}} ({{tr:aḥadan}}) closes the ayah by placing the singular indefinite under negation: not anyone at all. The final word moves from the inanimate record back to persons, and its echo with 18:47 joins two guarantees: no person left out of gathering and no person wronged in judgment.

topics.headline: anyone-at-all closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah closing on the irreducible individual after traversing book, criminals, deeds, and Lord.
topics.reason: The accusative indefinite under negation yields universal negative-polarity force while the singular form preserves individual distribution.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الاكتتاب في الفرض والرزق، وكتابة الاسم في ديوان السلطان، ومعنى اجعلنا في زمرة الشاهدين.
branches.scope_en: The branch covers registering oneself in an allotment or official roll and being counted or enrolled among a group.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Intentional acts become found objects.** `ع م ل` B001 (“intentional doing and work”) is not merely reported; `و ج د` B001 (“finding and coming upon a thing”) makes the agents encounter their work present. This reverses the garden owner’s imagined finding of unearned good (18:36). I infer that action is preserved into an objective environment of encounter. The record does not manufacture guilt; it discloses what agency has made.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:103–105 revealed why present works can later be found yet possess no weight: orientation governs durability.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Counting converts past action into present encounter.** `ح ص ي/B002` is counting by number until the object is encompassed; its concrete `ح ص ي/B001` is pebbles. The double totalization `صَغِيرَة/كَبِيرَة` and `وَجَدُوا مَا عَمِلُوا حَاضِرًا` follows the no-one-left gathering and row of 18:47–48. I infer that enumeration does not merely summarize deeds but gives each one discrete, pebble-like retrievability. `أَحْصَاهَا` reads as an operation that makes action confrontably present.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:50–52 separated false ally, non-witness, and unresponsive partner one by one, extending exhaustive counting into relational audit.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its small-and-great expenditure is explicitly written down for recompense, closely paralleling the record that omits nothing.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The passing-world parable begins the immediate contrast between worldly display and the coming accounting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The criminals' sight of the Fire immediately follows the presented record and carries its judgment forward.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contrasts manipulation of a revealed book and worldly gain with the better Hereafter, giving a broader book-and-accountability setting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its counting concerns the sleepers' duration, not a record of human deeds.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Evil and self-wronging remain personally answerable, though repentance introduces mercy absent from the focus scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The complete gathering of every person is the immediate precondition for the book's presentation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contrasts transient wealth and children with enduring righteous deeds just before the accounting scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It supplies the opposite judgment outcome: works lose all weight on the Day because of disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: No act, smaller or greater, escapes divine witnessing or the clear book, directly matching exhaustive recordkeeping.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The numbered years of the cave episode do not clarify the judgment record or present deeds.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Human inability to enumerate blessings is only a contrast to the divine exhaustive count of deeds.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly joins the placement of the Book, true judgment, and the assurance that none is wronged.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The people are displayed before their Lord immediately before the Book is placed and inspected.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The lack of a helper for one cursed by God does not add to the record, enumeration, or accounting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's witness to hypocrites' lies gives only a general accountability connection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The ensuing account of Iblis's disobedience supplies wrongdoing context but does not develop the Book.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The verse's fear and nullified deeds are not tied to the focus's accounting scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It closely repeats the image of wrongdoers fearful of what they earned, with the consequence already upon them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The disavowal of misleading witnesses at creation does not illuminate the recorded-deed judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Obedience to a command and patience in Abraham's trial do not add a focused record or recompense parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Fabricating a book for gain and receiving woe gives a limited contrast to the true comprehensive Book.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate judgment scene of failed calls to alleged partners continues the criminals' helplessness after the record.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command to fight nearby disbelievers is unrelated to the record or reckoning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its bare reference to criminals supplies only the identity of those questioned in the surrounding passage.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Human contentiousness after Quranic examples offers local context for the rejection underlying the judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The garden owner's denial of the Hour and presumptuous return anticipates the correction delivered by the Book.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The established balance offers a broad justice image but not a personal record of deeds.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Refusal of guidance and delayed punishment extends the local movement from warning to the appointed consequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Associating partners causes works to fail, clarifying why deeds may have no saving value at judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Each receives degrees according to what it did, with full requital and no injustice.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Disbelievers' futile disputation and mockery provide the local moral setting of the criminal judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its denier of the Hour is told of what he did and punished, a related accountability sequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God has enumerated forgotten deeds and will inform people of them, directly reinforcing the focus's exhaustive count.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Forgetting what one's hands sent ahead explains the culpability of those confronted by their record.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: No refuge from God is a general judgment consequence rather than an account of the Book.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: False objects of worship cannot avert punishment; the wrongdoer receives the stated consequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The merciful delay of punishment has a fixed appointment and no refuge, continuing the local judgment horizon.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Quran's internal coherence does not clarify the eschatological book of deeds.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Fear in earthly life only loosely anticipates the criminals' fear before the record.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Destroyed towns because of wrongdoing and their appointed end offer a local precedent for accountable judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The employment term and marriage agreement have no material link to the final record.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Counting the sleepers is an epistemic issue, not an accounting of acts.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's knowledge of what people do offers only a general basis for accountability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Degrees correspond to deeds, and the Lord is not unaware of what people do.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Dhu al-Qarnayn's choice between punishment and kindness is a limited human judgment, not the final Book.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God does not wrong people; their wrong is self-inflicted, directly supporting the focus's closing assurance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Finding forefathers worshipping idols does not develop the record or its judgment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The objection 'what is this messenger' only shares wording, not the Book's exhaustive account.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's encompassing knowledge and sight of deeds provide a general foundation for the record.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Distorting words and disobedience give a remote wrongdoing context without a reckoning connection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Reward for those who act gives a general recompense parallel but not the focus's accounting mechanism.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its insistence on writing every debt, small or great, is a concrete but worldly analogue of complete documentation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Finding returned merchandise does not clarify finding one's deeds present.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The criminals' state of error and blaze names the condemned group without adding the accounting relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The inhabitants of Hell find no escape, a consequence that follows the focus's criminal reckoning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies the recompense of arrogant deniers as the recompense of criminals.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Counting a divorce waiting period is a separate legal use of enumeration.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states the enduring Hell punishment of criminals, extending the focus's feared outcome.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Following forefathers' practice does not illuminate recorded personal deeds.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The failure of wealth and children on the Day supplies a broad judgment context only.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God recompenses evildoers and benefactors according to what they did, directly supporting act-to-outcome justice.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The insertion of denial into criminals' hearts does not develop the Book or enumeration.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Appeal to inherited practice has no distinct relation to the final record.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The manumission contract and social commands do not clarify the focus's judgment account.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's knowledge of what messengers do supports the general premise of deeds being known and answerable.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those who conceal fear become regretful when God's decision arrives, a partial exposure-and-remorse parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Noah's lack of knowledge of followers' deeds is a limited contrast to God's complete knowledge.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human activity is externalized into an object that can be placed, counted, found, valued, or denied weight.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The gravest failure is not inactivity but labor whose apparent craft cannot survive translation into weight.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Placed Record Makes Every Act Present
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A written record is set in view, prompting fearful recognition that no small or large action has escaped exhaustive enumeration.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: placement in view `و ض ع:B001/m01`; organized writing `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; fixed record `ك ت ب:B003/m01`; criminal liability `ج ر م:B004/m01`; fearful concern `ش ف ق:B003/m01`; smallness `ص غ ر:B001/m01`; largeness `ك ب ر:B001/m01`; exhaustive counting `ح ص ي:B002/m01`; confronting what is found `و ج د:B001/m01`; intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`; made-present object `ح ض ر:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:49 (the record placed, alarm at its exhaustive count, and all deeds found present)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The record abolishes the distance between doing and consequence. Scale does not matter to inclusion: every act reappears as a present item before judgment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Supposition Is Defeated by Exhaustive Accounting
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Surface-based estimation misclassifies scale, state, durability, and value, whereas exhaustive count or final disclosure fixes what the object actually is.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The contrast joins visual illusion, economic confidence, false allegiance, and skilled labor under one epistemic failure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Exhaustive Count Converts Hidden Duration and Deed into Evidence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The cave interval and the moral record are both subjected to a count that reaches the furthest term and omits no scale of action.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: exhaustive counting `ح ص ي:B002/m01`; enumeration `ع د د:B001/m01`; temporal endpoint `ء م د:B001/m01`; organized writing `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; smallness `ص غ ر:B001/m01`; largeness `ك ب ر:B001/m01`; made-present object `ح ض ر:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:11-12 (numbered years and exhaustive comparison of duration); 18:49 (written record, small and large acts counted and present)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Count corrects supposition by turning what was inaccessible into a complete object. Hidden time becomes a bounded interval, and dispersed deeds become a present record.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Authoritative Text Moves from Guidance to Evidence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The written book first directs conduct, then stands beyond human replacement, and finally appears as the fixed evidence of conduct.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Reader and record exchange positions: people first stand before the book's guidance, then their own actions stand present in a book.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Placed Book Converts Conduct into Fixed Evidence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A written record is set before its subjects and makes every small and large action present.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: placement in view `و ض ع:B001/m01`; organized writing `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; fixed record `ك ت ب:B003/m01`; exhaustive counting `ح ص ي:B002/m01`; smallness `ص غ ر:B001/m01`; largeness `ك ب ر:B001/m01`; made-present object `ح ض ر:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 18:49 (book placed, exhaustive inclusion, and deeds found present)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The book's final role is evidentiary rather than directive. What readers did in relation to guidance is reorganized into an object that can no longer be revised by its subjects.

Yapı kurma ve kayıt ortaya çıkarma gibi kullanımlar ancak ayrı kalıplar olarak korunmalıdır; yalın dalın genel anlamı bunlara genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi eldeki ya da yüksek konumdan indirip belirli bir yere koyma; aynı alan, nesnenin konduğu yeri de adlandırır.

Eylem alanından nesnenin konduğu yer veya konum adı gelişir.
Kanıt, kimi yerde indirmeyi öne çıkarır, kimi yerde daha geniş bir yerine koyma işini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak birleştirme çekirdeğini korur; dikme, bağlama, kapatma ve birlik düzenleme anlamlarını yalnızca tanıklanmış biçim ve yapılara bağlı özelleşmeler olarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeye katıp aralarında fiziksel ya da topluluk oluşturan bir bağ kurmaktır. Derileri dikme, açıklıkları bağlama veya kapatma ve insan ya da atları düzenli bir birlik hâline getirme bunun yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi başka bir şeye katarak ikisini bir bütün veya bağlı bir düzen içinde birleştirmektir.
Deri parçalarını ya da bir su tulumunu dikişle birleştirmek, çekirdeğin el işi alanındaki özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir hayvanın belirli uzuvlarını halka, kayış veya iple birbirine bağlamak ve bir kabın ağzını sıkıca kapatmak yapıya bağlı kullanımlardır.
Atların veya askerlerin toplanıp ayrı ve düzenli bir birlik oluşturması, fiziksel birleştirmeden topluluk düzenine uzanan anlamdır.
Kayışın iki yüzünü bir arada tutan boncuk, ortaya çıkan bağın somut bir örneğidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi harfleri çizgiyle düzenleyerek yazma işlemini, bunun ürünü olan yazılı metin veya sayfayı ve yazdırma, isteme ya da öğretme gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımları birlikte tanıklar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yazı üretimi ve yazılı ürünle sınırlıdır; yazının bağlayıcı hüküm için mecazlaşması ayrı dalda tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yazma işlemi ve yazılı ürün dalın merkezindedir; dikte ettirme, başkasından yazmasını isteme ve yazmayı öğretme anlamları yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Harfleri çizgiyle düzenleyerek yazılı bir metin oluşturmak ve bu işlemin ürünü olan metin ya da yazılı sayfadır. Birine yazdırma, ondan yazmasını isteme ve yazmayı öğretme ise belirli yapılara bağlı uzantılardır.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, harfleri yazıyla düzenleyip bir metin oluşturmak veya var olan metni kopyalamaktır.
İşlemin ürünü, yazılmış metin veya üzerinde bu metnin bulunduğu sayfa ya da kitaptır.
Bir metni başkasına söyleyerek yazdırmak ve birinden kendisi için yazmasını istemek yapıya bağlı ettirgen ve isteme kullanımlarıdır.
Yazmayı öğretmek, yazı öğretmeni ve öğretim yeri anlamları yazı edinimi alanındaki bağlı kullanımlardır.
Öğretim yerindeki çocuklar veya onların topluluğu için kullanılan biçim, yeri değil öğrencileri gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yazmayı harfleri çizgiyle bir araya getiren işlem olarak sunar; yazılı ürün, kopyalama, dikte ettirme, yazma isteği ve öğretimle ilgili kullanımlar bu merkeze bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem harflerden metin oluşturma işlemini hem de ortaya çıkan yazılı ürünü birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Yazı oluşturma işlemi ile yazılı ürün arasındaki temel anlam bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir metnin harflerle oluşturulduğu veya mevcut bir metnin yeniden yazıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yazı eyleminin başka bir kişiye yaptırılması anlamını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi yükümlülük, hüküm, paylaştırılmış yazgı veya kesinleşmiş karar olarak belirleme alanını açıkça toplar; burada yazı, harf çizme eylemi değil bağlayıcı biçimde belirlemenin anlatım yoludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Salt yazı yazmak bu dala girmez; belirleme işleminin yükümlülük, hüküm veya yazgı sonucu doğurması gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yükümlülük, hüküm ve yazgı değerleri birlikte korunur; birine zorunluluk yükleme ve Tanrı'nın belirlemesi anlamları yalnızca tanıklanmış yapılara bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük, hüküm veya gerçekleşmesi belirlenmiş pay ve yazgı olarak karara bağlamaktır. Yazma çağrışımı burada harf çizmekten çok kararın kesinleştirilip geçerli kılınmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir işi yapılması gereken bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük olarak belirlemek temel değerlerden biridir.
Bir konuda geçerli ve kesinleşmiş hüküm vermek aynı belirleme çekirdeğinin yargısal yönüdür.
Bir olayın payını, ölçüsünü veya gelecekte gerçekleşecek sonucunu önceden belirlemek yazgı yönünü oluşturur.
Yazma anlatımı, belirlenen hükmün saptanmış, yürürlüğe konmuş ve kesinleşmiş olmasını ifade eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yükümlülük, hüküm, yazgı, belirleme ve kesinleşmiş karar değerlerini aynı bağlayıcı saptama alanında birleştirir; yazma sözü bu saptamanın anlatım aracıdır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, genel yazma eylemini değil, adı kayda geçirerek kişiyi bir listeye veya belirli topluluğa dâhil etmeyi anlatır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin adını resmî bir pay, geçim veya yönetim kaydına geçirerek onu kayıtlılar arasına almak ya da kişiyi belirli bir topluluğun üyesi saymaktır.

facets.statement: Kişinin adını bir kayıt veya listeye geçirerek ona kayıtlı kişi konumu vermek dalın çekirdeğidir.
Adı pay, geçim tahsisatı veya yönetim siciline yazdırmak resmî kayıt alanındaki özel gerçekleşmedir.
Bir kişiyi tanıklar gibi belirli bir topluluğun içinde saymak, sicile almadan üyelik vermeye uzanan kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak içeriği, adı kayda geçirmenin kişiyi pay alanlar, yönetim sicilindekiler veya belirli bir topluluğun üyeleri arasına sokmasıdır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, her türlü yazılı sözleşmeyi değil, bedelin ödenmesiyle özgürlüğe götüren bu özel sözleşme türünü kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım özel sözleşme türüne bağlı kalır; sözleşmenin adı, tarafı ve sözleşme yapma eylemi ayrı tanıklanmış biçimler olarak korunur ve genel sözleşme anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Köleleştirilmiş kişinin, belirlenen bedeli kazancından ve kararlaştırılmış ödemelerle sahibine vererek özgürlüğünü kazanması için taraflar arasında yapılan özel sözleşmedir. Bedel tamamlandığında kişi özgür olur.

facets.statement: Sahip ile köleleştirilmiş kişi arasında, kişinin kendi özgürlük bedelini ödemesini konu alan özel bir sözleşme kurulur.
Bedel belirlenmiş ödeme dilimlerine bağlanır ve köleleştirilmiş kişi bunu kendi kazancından karşılar.
Kararlaştırılan bedelin tamamlanması sözleşmenin sonucu olarak köleleştirilmiş kişinin özgür olmasını sağlar.
İlgili biçimler sözleşmenin kendisini, sözleşmeye bağlı köleleştirilmiş kişiyi ve bağlama göre sözleşmenin öteki tarafını gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, özgürlük bedelinin kararlaştırılıp ödemelere bölündüğü, köleleştirilmiş kişinin bunu kazancıyla ödediği ve tamamlandığında özgürleştiği özel sözleşmede birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözleşmenin taraflarını, ödeme düzenini ve bedelin tamamlanmasıyla doğan özgürleşme sonucunu birlikte kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Özel sözleşme türünü, bedel ödeme koşulunu ve özgürleşme sonucunu eksiksiz korur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin bedeli ödemesi, ödemelerin aşamalı oluşu ve özgürleşme sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sahibin köleleştirilmiş kişiyle bu özel ödeme ve özgürleşme sözleşmesini kurduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tarafların özgürlük bedelini konu alan özel sözleşmeyi kurması anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, ödeme koşullarını ve özgürleşme sonucunu kuran sözleşmenin kendisini tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, köleleştirilmiş kişinin bedeli kazanmak için çalışmasını ve kalan payı tamamlama çabasını tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı özgürlük bedelinin ödenmesi ve kölelikten çıkma sürecinde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hukuki ilişkiyi ve ödeme yükümlülüğünü kurar; komşu dal ise bu yükümlülüğü yerine getirmek için gösterilen çalışma ve kazanç sürecidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, özgürlüğün ancak kararlaştırılan bedelin sözleşmeye göre ödenmesiyle kazanılmasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sözleşme veya bedel koşulu aramadan özgür olma ve kölelikten çıkarılma durumunu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kölelik durumunun sona ermesi ve kişinin özgürlüğe kavuşması sonucunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Özgürlük komşu dalın doğrudan çekirdeğidir; odak dalda ise özel bir sözleşme ve bedelin ödenmesiyle ulaşılan sonuçtur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda özgürleşme, kişinin kazancından yaptığı kararlaştırılmış ödemeleri tamamlamasına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda özgürleşme, sahibin ölümünden sonra gerçekleşmek üzere önceden verilmiş karara bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal özgürlüğün gelecekteki bir koşul gerçekleşince doğmasını düzenler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın koşulu bedelin sözleşmeye göre ödenmesidir; komşu dalın koşulu ise sahibin ölümü olup ödeme sözleşmesi bulunmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday komşular değerlendirildi; seçilenler sözleşme, bedeli kazanma, özgürleşme sonucu ve ölüm sonrası özgür bırakma arasındaki temel sınırları gösterir, kalanlar yalnızca aynı hukuk alanını paylaşır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عقد المكاتبة بين السيد والعبد أو الأمة على مال منجم، وكتابة الشرط والنجوم المؤدية إلى العتق.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مطلق الكتابة ولا كل عقد مكتوب، بل هذا الباب الفقهي الخاص بالمكاتب والمكاتبة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: المكاتب العبد يكاتبه سيده على نفسه (maqayis)؛ المكاتب الذي يشتري نفسه ويكاتب عليها (jamhara)؛ المكاتب العبد يكاتب على نفسه بثمنه فإذا سعى وأداه عتق (sihah)؛ معنى الكتاب والمكاتبة أن يكاتب الرجل عبده أو أمته على مال ينجمه عليه (tahdhib)؛ كتابة العبد ابتياع نفسه من سيده بما يؤديه من كسبه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
Bir şeyi gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan ve tanık olarak görme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gözle görmeyi temel alır ve bazı anlatımlarda bu algıyı içsel kavrayışa kadar genişletir; doğrudan göz tanıklığı özellikle belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: gözle ya da içsel kavrayışla görme
concept_gloss.applicability: Duyusal görme ile ona benzetilen içsel kavrayışın birlikte amaçlandığı genel anlatımda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gözle algılama çekirdeğini ve içsel kavrayış uzantısını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Anlatım yalnızca duyusal algıyı veya doğrudan göz tanıklığını gerektirdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Duyusal görmeyi ve doğrudan tanıklığı açık biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: İçsel kavrayışla görme olanağını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gözle değil, zihinsel veya içsel bir kavrayışla algılama bağlamında kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal algılanan şeyi görme eylemini ve bunun içsel kavrayış uzantısını anlatır; komşu dal ise göz duyusunu ve gözün görür duruma getirilmesini de kendi çekirdeğine alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İçsel kavrayışı ve genel görsel algıyı doğrudan tanıklığın yanında kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yüz yüze görme ile kesinlik ve ilk elden tanıklık vurgusunu çekirdeğe yerleştirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyi doğrudan gözle görme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kapsamı genel görmeden içsel kavrayışa uzanır; komşu dal doğrudan karşılaşma ve gözle kesin tanıklık sınırında daha dardır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyi algılamış olmayı ve görmenin gerçekleşmesini bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi anlamak için bakışı sürdürme, sınama ve dikkatle inceleme sürecini bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal gözün bir nesneye yönelmesini gerektirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal algının sonucunu veya gerçekleşmesini anlatır; komşu dal ise algıya ulaşmak için yapılan dikkatli ve süreli bakışı anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak ekseni, bir konu hakkında zihinsel bir yargı veya görüş oluşturmaktır. Bilme ya da sanma değeri belirli tümce yapılarında, danışma ise başka birinin görüşünü istemede ortaya çıkar; bunlar yalın çekirdeğin eş düzeyli anlamları sayılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Görüş, kanı ve düşünerek karar verme çekirdektir; bilme, sanma ve danışma yapıya bağlı gerçekleşimlerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın zihinsel yargı ile düşünme, danışma ve göz tanıklığına bağlı sanma kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir konu hakkında düşünüp zihinde bir görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturmaktır. Derinlemesine düşünme bu sonuca götüren süreçtir; danışma başka birinin yargısını isteme, belirli tümce yapılarıysa bilme ya da sanma değeridir.

facets.statement: Bir konu hakkında zihinde görüş, kanı veya yargı oluşturma.
Bir görüşe ulaşmak için konuyu ağır ağır ve farklı yönleriyle düşünme.
Başka birinden görüş isteme veya belirli bir yapıda bilme ve sanma bildirme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar zihinsel görüş ve inancı ortaklaştırır; düşünerek görüşe varma, bir başkasına danışma ve belirli yapılardaki bilme ya da sanma değerleri bu eksenin bağlı gerçekleşimleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir konu hakkında zihinsel değerlendirme yapıp görüş veya yargı oluşturma çekirdeğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Düşünme sürecini ve bunun görüş ya da yargı sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir durum hakkında kesin bilgi değil, kanı veya sanı bildirildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Zihinsel yargı ve kanı oluşturma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Danışma ve uzun düşünme süreçlerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir başkasından değerlendirme veya öneri istenen danışma yapılarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasının zihinsel yargısını isteme uzantısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin kendi görüşünü oluşturması ve bilme değeri dışarıda kalır.

düşünüp taşınmak ve bir görüşe varmak

error_profile.adds: Duyusal göz algısını birincil anlam gibi öne çıkarır.
error_profile.collision: Gözle algılama dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir görüş veya yargı oluşturup onu benimseme yönünün bulunması.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi açıkça uyuyan kişinin uykuda gördüğü şeyi ve bunun çoğulunu bildirir. Uyanıkken gözle görmek, zihinsel görüş ve düşü yorumlama bu kimliğin parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca uyku sırasında görülen düşü adlandırır; uyanık algı ve yorumlama ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal uyku sırasında görülen düş anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve başka yapılara bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Uyuyan bir kişinin uyku sırasında gördüğü düş veya düş görüntüsüdür. Adın çoğul biçimi de aynı türden birden çok uyku deneyimini bildirir.

facets.statement: Uyku sırasında görülen düş veya görüntü.
Aynı uyku deneyiminin tekil ve çoğul adlandırmaları.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı uyku sırasında görülen düş olarak tanımlar ve tekil adın birden çok düşü bildiren çoğul biçimini de kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Uyuyan kişinin gördüğü tek bir düşü veya genel olarak bu uyku deneyimini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Uyku koşulunu ve görülen düş içeriğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Uyku sırasında bir görüntü veya olay dizisi yaşama eylemi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uyku içindeki görsel ya da yaşantısal deneyimi doğal Türkçeyle korur.
Göz önünde beliren bir görüntü düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.adds: Uyku dışında sezgi, tasarım veya uyanık görüntü anlamlarını da çağırır.
error_profile.collision: Uyanık görme ve zihinsel kavrayışla karışabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uyku sırasında görülen şeyi ve onun çoğul adını yalın biçimde bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Cinsel içerikli uyku deneyimini ve görülmemiş bir düşü gördüğünü ileri sürmeyi de kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: düş ile geniş uyku görüsü alanı
